'''2017 EGP Day 2 Kyle Krueger LS Old Allies''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Kyle Krueger]] at [[2017 Endor Grand Prix]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Kyle Krueger]]
* '''Event:''' [[2017 Endor Grand Prix]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Old Allies / We Need Your Help|Old Allies]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/resources/tournament-decklists/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261013125443/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/tournament-decklists.html Internet Archive]
